query: Which coach talked John Lynch out of quitting football for baseball?
test_description: Natural-language question naming the subject. The answer is Bill Walsh, who in 1992 talked Lynch out of signing with the Marlins. Passage retrieval should land on the office-meeting passage rather than merely on the right document. Note the near-miss distractor inside the same documents: Denny Green tried to talk Lynch into staying at quarterback, and Dave Tipton pushed him toward safety, so a shallow match on 'coach' plus 'talked into' can retrieve the wrong episode.
